about_the_game:
Chilly Warmth BGM Pack is an RPG Maker official music pack focusing on the combination of opposites within melodies.

When warmth and cold, empty and full, distant and familiar combine under the sound of a melody that lingers to be whole... that is Chilly Warmth BGM Pack.

  

■ Ideal for winter-themed games, story-focused RPGs (especially in isolated areas) with melancholic, yet hopeful settings, or themes of mystique and coldness while also maintaining diversity of tone.

 

■ Carefully compressed to take very little storage size, without losing quality, making it great for mobile formats.

 

■ The tracks loop melodically by design, so the developer doesn’t need to manually make them loop.

 

■ Combines contrasting elements that feel complimentary and unique in their wholeness.

Primarily composed in 3/4th time signature to signify an upbeat yet never-ending movement.

 

■ A big number of tracks (23 in total) offering a complete OST to the developer.

 

■ Merges minor and major modes, consonance and dissonance, using cold-sounding and warm-sounding instruments.

 

■ Strong emphasis on melody, combining classic RPG characteristics with unique sounds. It marries sadness to happiness, in a bittersweet way.
